why: Both analyses land on the same hedgehog (most convenient pharmacy-led corner drugstore, profit per customer visit) and the same refusals: no scale acquisition, mail/PBM kept in support of the stores, and no weak sites to hit 3,000. Analysis 2 edges ahead because its brutal facts also cover payers and mail-order steering where prescriptions are filled, and its warnings come with explicit trigger thresholds and a caution that the record streak could become a goal in itself.
